observations: The body reads the RootComponent (AActor::RootComponent at +0x130) rotation quaternion (+0x1c0) and converts it to the actor forward vector; when RootComponent is null the forward defaults to identity (GetActorForwardVector semantics).

It normalizes HitDirection and calls the generic signed-angle helper FUN_142c521d0(forward, hitDir, up, out). The helper computes magnitude via acos of the clamped dot and a second value via asin (unused by this caller); out[0] is the signed angle in radians, out[1] the asin value.

out[0] is multiplied by 57.295776 (= 180/PI) to degrees; the sign is derived from the up axis (cross-product sign), i.e. the standard UE4 signed-angle idiom. Representation of the helper as FMath::Acos + up-axis cross sign is an idiom-level equivalence, not a byte-for-byte match of the helper (MEDIUM confidence).

Classification on |degrees|: <= 45 -> NameFront; >= 120 -> NameLeft; 45 < |deg| < 120 -> NameRight when signed deg > 0 else NameLeft. NameBack is a parameter that is never written (red herring in the original).
remaining_questions: The signed-angle helper FUN_142c521d0 is represented with the standard UE4 idiom (acos magnitude + up-axis cross sign); a byte-for-byte re-derivation of its exact sign rule was not performed.
NameBack is accepted but unused in the original; the proposal mirrors that.
